activity.notes: Petar Krešimir IV ruled approximately from 1058 until 1074. Contemporary evidence attests him as king of Croatia and Dalmatia, so ATLAS uses that historical royal polity/title rather than a generic modern Croatia label. The accession boundary is approximate because reconstruction of his reign is complicated by disputed charter authenticity.

sources.title: Hrvatska enciklopedija — Petar Krešimir IV.
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia identifies Petar Krešimir IV as Croatian king approximately 1058–1074 and the first ruler for whom contemporary sources attest the title king of Croatia and Dalmatia.

review_context.correction_note: Register the historically attested king of Croatia and Dalmatia with approximate accession.
